description.en: Nordenskioldia-inspired preserved fruiting axis organ only: a slender axis carries four separated radial segmented fruits on persistent receptacles, with visible wedge-shaped fruitlet boundaries. Ten fruitlets per teaching fruit are an artistic simplification, not the source specimens counted thirteen/fifteen. No separate seed asset, unknown whole tree, flowers or leafy crown.
description.zh: Nordenskioldia启发保存果序轴器官：细轴带四个分隔清楚的放射分段果，接入宿存果托，小楔形果片边界可读。每果十片是教学简化，不冒称原标本十三/十五片计数；不另计种子，不造未知整树、花或叶冠。

artistic_choices.en: Nominal dimensions, original palette, exact repeated-feature counts and static pose are artistic. No strict species, specimen-copy, locomotion, animation or coexistence reconstruction.

structural_scope.en: Preserved slender fruit axis with four radial segmented fruits and persistent receptacles. Wedge fruitlet boundaries stay clear; model ten-part count is artistic, source thirteen/fifteen not imposed. No whole tree, leaf crown, flower or separate seed asset.
structural_scope.zh: 保存细果序轴与四个放射分段果和宿存果托；楔形果片边界清楚，模型十片属艺术简化，不强套原标本十三/十五片。无整树叶冠、花或独立种子资产。
